scope: Threat model and constructive analytical controls, not exhaustive proof all cornercases have been handled.
certainty_semantics: Conditional on declared observation and model. Neither evidence declaration nor residual is a physical certificate.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: uniform grid without reliable major/minor distinction or units
registered_control_cases.operational_action: retain pitch hypotheses1/5/10 and other supported families; do not label coordinatesmm from point residual
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: No claim all ECG paper has these exact aliases. Reliable unit conventions can exclude worlds.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: square crop with pure square grid and no semantic cue
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: asymmetric known-upright text with reflection interpretation
registered_control_cases.operational_action: export D4 candidates and chart-relative geometry; preserve source for review
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: An asymmetric border or readable text may break some or all symmetry.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: detector drops every second major line while intermediate lines remain inRGB
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: joint edge jump labeling with latent integer differences
registered_control_cases.operational_action: revisit source lines, permit jumps greater than1, relabel rather than only smooth fixedIDs
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: Information loss by frontend is not an information-theoretic limit of the original image.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: orthographic developable strips with hidden20mm or25mm bridge and5mm grid phase
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: supported whole-plane constraint that excludes fold
registered_control_cases.operational_action: keep all components and phase hypotheses; never drop all but largest or force one global origin
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: A trustworthy plane model may register disconnected visible islands. Uncertain plane assumption is not evidence.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: blank developable V strip, orthographic camera, constant radiance, unknown arc length
registered_control_cases.operational_action: preserve visibleRGB, expose uncertainty and chart-relative map; do not certify interpolation solely from flanking grid
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: Real shading/texture can add information. This is not an assertion every blank strip is unrecoverable.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: orientation-preservingC1 maps allowing2D material deformation with blank interior
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: justified curvature bound with error envelope
registered_control_cases.operational_action: report model-conditional interpolation and spatial support; do not convert roundtrip to physical-error bound
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: No universal impossibility theorem for nonstretchable paper or calibrated planar perspective.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: periodic crop without physical origin or crop provenance
registered_control_cases.operational_action: keep origin gauge explicit and do not turn arbitrary canvas zero into signal zero
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: M3 translation gauge removes global origin for shape comparison only. Baseline is separate from page origin.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: symmetricII font token on symmetric grid
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: asymmetric glyph with reliable upright convention
registered_control_cases.operational_action: evaluate reflection explicitly, propagate OCR alternatives and flag conflicting cues
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: Ordinary asymmetric text may make orientation identifiable. Control positiveF has8 distinct views, not anOCR accuracy benchmark.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: two parallel strips joined by semicylindrical hinge under orthographic camera
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: depth and visibility plus additional observation of hidden surface
registered_control_cases.operational_action: export visible charts and visibility; reject one global inverse over both layers; do not hallucinate hidden traces
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: Visibility can make the inverse single-valued on the front chart, never on all folded material from the same pixel.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: distinct document content fully hidden under opaque foreground
registered_control_cases.operational_action: archive visible source; mark hidden material unknown; keep any inpainting separate from observed output
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: Not a claim of irrecoverability when another source of information exists.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: expected uniqueI/II metadata but reliable observedII/II labels
registered_control_cases.operational_action: retain conflict and competing assignments; use trace IDs and time windows for legitimate repeatedII strips
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: RepeatedII is common in some layouts and is not itself invalid. Contradiction depends on explicit unique-lead premise.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: unknown original grid family versus square5mm original stretched1.1x0.9
registered_control_cases.operational_action: keep original-documentmm and photocopy-papermm separate; correct both axes using trustworthy original grid
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: Do not describe ordinary anisotropic photocopy stretch as uncorrectable with known square grid. Different targets explain alias.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: composite page with known5mm and10mm panel intervals at20px spacing
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: separate lead namespaces and time windows
registered_control_cases.operational_action: segment charts and keep inter-panel alignment unknown unless independently linked
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: The control rejects one shared scalar, not every conceivable global nonuniform warp.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: same drawn trace with speed/gain legend and independently known calibration pulse absent
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: pulse with known amplitude and duration
registered_control_cases.operational_action: output geometry inmm while signal units remain absent or candidates; never infer calibration by making waveform typical
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: The missing-pulse wording means absent independent known calibration. Generic displayed pulse without trustworthy units is not enough.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: grid-free box containing visible text and trace
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: geometric prior or other anchors only for warp, never for deciding whetherRGB exists
registered_control_cases.operational_action: preserveRGB and separate source footprint, geometry support and visibility; keep identity fallback exact
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: Does not claimM3 currently masksRGB by grid. CurrentM3 audit says the source and fallback are preserved.

registered_control_cases.admissible_world_class: four ordered asymmetric fiducials with physical coordinates available as input
additional_evidence_that_can_resolve: already provided input fiducial identities andmm coordinates
registered_control_cases.operational_action: document evidence that breaks symmetry; fit within declared model and retain new-data risk evaluation requirement
registered_control_cases.scope_limit: Not anECG inference result, not gold-assisted selection and not proof fiducials are available on ordinary documents.

additional_threats_not_experimented.threat: 2.5mm or nonmetric graph paper, ECG printed on graph-like decorative background
dotted and double lines produce different harmonics
additional_threats_not_experimented.required_response: line family hypotheses and phase aliases

additional_threats_not_experimented.threat: red grid drops out while black trace survives
additional_threats_not_experimented.required_response: no-grid RGB preservation plus externalunit evidence
multiscale periodicity uncertainty and adverse sampling controls
RGB line integration with image-quality uncertainty
explicit capture model or partial/unsupported geometry
original versus current metric target and physicalprior validation

additional_threats_not_experimented.threat: backprint may be mistaken for frontgrid or trace
distinct sheets overlap or are composed intooneJPEG
image may still contain useful waveform andtext
additional_threats_not_experimented.required_response: document-semantic calibration or relative geometry withunknownmm

additional_threats_not_experimented.threat: one page may have multiple speed/gain settings

additional_threats_not_experimented.required_response: multitrace assignment and provenance, notonecurve prior

additional_threats_not_experimented.threat: pulse or unit label cut atcropedge
